content: {"episode_id":"ep-05045","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42), a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), and known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). The monitoring was indicated to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. The clinical indication note documenting these findings supports the medical necessity of the service billed under CPT 93229, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on that basis."}
